headline: Building an AI Chatbot App with React Native: Scope, Cost & Timeline

itemListElement.name: Building an AI Chatbot App with React Native

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an AI chatbot app?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the tier. A simple FAQ-style bot on top of an existing app is a small build; a grounded assistant with retrieval, voice or the ability to take actions adds backend, data and evaluation work that raises both the build and the running cost. The build is predictable; the per-token running cost scales with usage. Our app cost calculator gives an instant indicative range for your feature set.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build an AI chatbot in React Native?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple FAQ bot can ship in 2–3 weeks. A grounded assistant with retrieval is more like 4–8 weeks, and an advanced assistant that takes actions or handles voice and multiple languages runs 8 weeks and up. Most of the time goes into retrieval quality and evaluation, not the chat UI.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between an AI chatbot and an AI agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: A chatbot answers; an agent acts. A chatbot responds in natural language, optionally grounded in your data. An agent goes further by calling your functions and APIs to complete multi-step tasks autonomously. Many products start as a chatbot and grow agentic features over time.

mainEntity.name: Do I need RAG for my chatbot?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the bot must answer from your specific documents, policies or data accurately, yes — retrieval-augmented generation grounds answers in your facts and prevents confident hallucination. If it only needs general conversation or simple scripted flows, you can start without it.
